name: Cisco ASA — Large Outbound TCP Egress (≥50MB)
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014"
| alter src_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
        dst_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
        src_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
        dst_port = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_port),
        src_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_interface,
        dst_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface,
        proto    = _json -> generalCiscoLog.protocol,
        bytes_n  = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
| filter src_if = "inside" and dst_if = "outside" and bytes_n >= 50000000
| alter int_host = src_host, ext_host = dst_host, int_port = src_port, ext_port = dst_port
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp sum(bytes_n) as egress_bytes,
       values(ext_host) as ext_hosts,
       values(ext_port) as ext_ports,
       values(int_port) as int_ports,
       values(proto) as protocols
       by int_host, _time
| filter egress_bytes >= 50000000
| fields int_host, ext_hosts, ext_ports, int_ports, protocols, egress_bytes
description: Cisco ASA Teardown (302014) from internal host with transferred_bytes ≥ 50MB summed across one hour — bulk data exfiltration.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — Large Outbound TCP Egress (≥50MB)
alert_description:
What fired: Cisco ASA Teardown (302014) from internal host with transferred_bytes ≥ 50MB summed across one hour — bulk data exfiltration.

Why it matters: data may be leaving the environment through this channel. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1041 - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (TA0010 - Exfiltration).

Investigate:
  - Quantify the volume and destination, and identify the user/host/principal moving the data.
  - Correlate with prior collection/staging and any defense-evasion steps; confirm the destination is not an approved service.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (int_host) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
